name: status-band
description: Claude Cockpit: a dashboard above the prompt with context %, cache countdown, 5-hour and weekly limits, one-click Handoff to a fresh chat, and a tokenless bug-fixing crab game while Claude works: the crab changes costume and the world around it as your score climbs.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Minutes the prompt cache stays warm after a response (60 = extended cache, 5 = standard).

costume.title: Game character
costume.description: Which Claude crab runs in the game: auto = the journey (the costume and the world change as your score climbs), or pick one costume to keep.

buddy.title: While Claude works
buddy.description: game = animated mascot, plus a runner game offered on long turns; mascot = animation only; off = nothing. Drawn on your machine, never spends tokens.

motion.title: Game motion
motion.description: smooth = the picture is played ahead and animated by the display (steady at any speed); classic = redrawn every step like 0.10.
